subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Dhow and tanker: comparing pictures; skimming a text
outcomes: Describe and compare a dhow and an oil tanker
Skim a text quickly to get the gist
Choose the best title for a text and explain why

tf.s: The tanker is the ship that carries oil.
tf.why: Yes, an oil tanker carries oil.

tf.s: The dhow is powered by wind.
tf.why: Right, a dhow uses a sail and the wind.

tf.s: The tanker is made of wood and has a triangular sail.
tf.why: That describes the dhow; the tanker is made of steel.

tf.s: Both the dhow and the tanker were used to export goods from Arab lands.
tf.why: That is the connection between the two ships.

tf.s: Skimming means reading every word slowly and carefully.
tf.why: Skimming is reading quickly to get the main idea.

tf.s: We skim a text to get the gist, or overall idea.
tf.why: Yes, skimming gives you the general idea fast.

tf.s: When skimming, you can read the title and the first lines of paragraphs.
tf.why: These parts often show what the text is about.

tf.s: The best title for a text covers only one small part of it.
tf.why: A good title covers the whole text.

tf.s: Dhows carried goods such as silk and spices.
tf.why: Yes, dhows carried a variety of goods.

tf.s: Skimming is never useful when reading a newspaper.
tf.why: Skimming helps you decide which articles to read in detail.

boxes.why: The modern tanker uses powerful engines.

boxes.q: What is the dhow made of?
boxes.why: The traditional dhow is made of wood.

boxes.q: What is the gist of a text?
boxes.why: The gist is the main, general idea.

boxes.q: Which title best fits the text about trade?
o: Trading in Ancient and Modern Times
boxes.why: Title d covers the whole text.

boxes.q: What shape is the dhow's sail?
boxes.why: The dhow has a triangular sail.
Exporting is selling goods to other countries.

boxes.q: Why is trade between nations important?
o: countries get goods they cannot produce
boxes.why: Trade brings essential goods and cooperation.

boxes.q: Which is ancient: the dhow or the tanker?
boxes.why: The dhow is the traditional, ancient ship.

boxes.q: What is a good reason to skim?
o: to choose articles for a project
boxes.why: Skimming helps you pick useful texts quickly.

hunt.q: Reading fast for the main idea

o: to get the gist of a text
mcq.why: Skimming gives the overall idea quickly.
The tanker is a modern ship with engines.
Dhows carried goods like silk and spices.

mcq.q: What can you look at first when you skim?
mcq.why: The title and opening lines show the topic.

mcq.q: You have 2 minutes to find out what an article is about. What should you do?
mcq.why: Skimming is the fastest way to get the gist.

mcq.q: A text talks about trade long ago and trade today. Which title fits best?
o: Trading in Ancient and Modern Times
mcq.why: The best title covers both ancient and modern trade.

mcq.q: You are looking for articles for a school project. How can skimming help?
o: It helps you choose useful articles fast
mcq.why: Skimming lets you check many texts quickly.

mcq.q: What is the connection between the dhow and the tanker?
o: Both export goods from Arab lands
mcq.why: Both ships carry important goods to other countries.

mcq.q: Why are some titles not suitable for the trade text?
o: They cover only part of the text
mcq.why: A good title must fit the whole text.

mcq.q: How is the dhow different from the tanker?
o: It is ancient and carried a variety of goods
It is modern and carries oil
It is bigger and uses engines
mcq.why: The dhow is old and wind-powered; the tanker is modern.
